scope: Repository-only read-only gameplay audit. Only these two audit documents are written. No runtime verification or complete game catalog claimed.
authoritative_selection: index.toml and current packwiz metadata, not the named Modrinth profile

selection_reconciliation.concurrent_index_update: The full index hash changed during concurrent handbook work. Rechecked selected artifact paths and their complete index entries at completion; no artifact selection or metadata index entry changed. The source hash records the inspected starting snapshot.

limitations: Packaged definitions are not effective runtime registries or a world-generation success count.
No loaded registries, natural spawns, room generation, recipe manager, encounters or saves were inspected.
Structure definitions, placement sets, room pools, templates, entity types and cosmetic variants are different counting units.
English labels and raw artifact evidence do not establish translated or completed handbook entries.

gaps.question: Which bosses exist, where are they, and how is each encountered?
gaps.gap: No named boss catalog. Start with the 13 released tagged bosses, then audit Invoker, Wildfire, minibosses and vanilla encounters. Dangerous is a balancing layer, not evidence of another boss roster. Keep checklist informational, with no save-derived defeat state or guide gates.

gaps.question: Which hostile, neutral, passive and tameable creatures exist?
gaps.gap: No per-creature inventory. Distinguish registered types from colors, pets, projectiles, raid variants and behavior changes. Cross-list Cataclysm, Bosses'Rise, Illager Invasion and Supplementaries instead of limiting scope to the five creature-page providers.

gaps.question: Which structures and dungeon families exist, and which variants are enabled?
gaps.gap: Structure page lists nine mods, not a structure catalog. Add providers currently assigned to bosses, creatures, terrain, magic and furniture. Separate structures, placement grids, room pools and templates. Apply repository configuration and selected data-pack filters before describing availability.

gaps.question: Which weapons, armor, jewelry and relics can I obtain?
gaps.gap: No equipment index. Include boss rewards and class equipment, not only Armory and Arsenal. Curios is a slot framework, not a jewelry catalog. Do not infer class progression support from shared combat compatibility.

installed_providers.name: More RPG Classes - Skill Tree (RPG Series Plus)

gaps.question: Which spells, active abilities and passive skills exist?
gaps.gap: Authored skills page only points at interfaces. Packaged spell files include passive skill definitions, internal mechanics and equipment triggers; raw file counts are not player spell totals.

gaps.question: Which material families, shapes, furniture and building tools exist?
gaps.gap: Copycats article is orientation, not a shape inventory. Inventory generated compatibility families separately from base blocks. Supplementaries also contributes encounters and structures.

gaps.question: Which vehicle, transport, control and propulsion systems exist?
gaps.gap: All seven vehicle topics are unwritten. Component and capability index must precede example builds. Do not imply aircraft classes are prebuilt entities. Space and its transfer bridges are deferred, not installed gameplay.

gaps.question: Which ingredients, crops, catches, meals and food systems exist?
gaps.gap: Two authored orientation pages are not a food catalog. Fishing topic has no mapped providers although Spawn supplies fish and capture mechanics. Record food properties separately from Onion rewards and temporary effects.

gaps.question: Which machines, resources, power systems and containers exist?
gaps.gap: Ore-processing examples establish a few recipes only. Build resource and machine indexes with native recipe browser and Ponder references, then write substantial operating articles.

raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.angler_fish.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob found in Deep Waters, where it attracts prey with its lure. Deflates on Land. Fits in a bucket.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.tuna.description: An aquatic passive mob that can be bred. Doesn't fit in a Bucket when grown up.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.tuna_egg.description: A squishy small egg that grows into a baby Tuna eventually.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.seahorse.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob found in Reefs and Seagrass Meadows. Comes in many shapes, sizes and colors based on where its found. Fits into a Bucket.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.snail.description: A passive mob found in forests that produces Mucus when wet. It has a shell that can be knocked off with Projectiles and retreated into for protection.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.hamster.description: A passive mob found in open grassy areas that can be tamed with Sunflower Seeds. It collects items and stores them in its cheek pouches, which can be accessed by its owner. Territorial and energetic, cannot withstand extreme temperatures.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.ant.description: A neutral mob found in Anthills. It brings resources to its home and helps decompose blocks. When hatched from an Ant Pupa it follows and protects its owner, also attacking other ants with different colored Abdomens.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.boat.description: A two-passenger vehicle for traversing rivers and oceans.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.chest_boat.description: A single-passenger vehicle that has its own storage.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.clam.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob found in Oceans and Beaches. Can be collected by hand and with a Casting Net.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.sea_cow.description: A passive mob found in Seagrass Meadows that can be milked using a bucket. Grows Seagrass on its back and eats Tall Seagrass, occasionally finding Loot in it if fed before. Doesn't fit into a Bucket when grown up. Drops leather.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.flukeshroom.description: A passive mob found in Mushroom Fields that can be milked for soup using a bowl. Transforms when struck by lightning.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.octopus.description: An aquatic ambient mob rarely found in oceans. Can be captured in a multitude of items, including Casting Nets.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.herring.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob found in Oceans schooling in big groups. Fits in a Bucket.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.pilot_fish.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob found circling bigger mobs. Fits in a Bucket.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.blenny.description: A really skittish aquatic ambient passive mob found in Tide Pools. Fits in a Bucket.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.bluefish.description: An aquatic ambient neutral mob found in Oceans and Cold Oceans. Can be thrown into a feeding frenzy if mobs nearby are hurt. Fits in a Bucket.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.sunfish.description: An aquatic ambient passive mob that can be found in Oceans. It basks during the day and swims near the bottom at night. Doesn't fit in a Bucket when fully grown up.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.stickbug.description: A common crafting material made from Planks.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.barracuda.description: An aquatic ambient neutral mob found in deep Lukewarm and Warm Oceans. Can be caught in a Casting Net.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.coastal_crab.description: A neutral mob found in coastal regions that can shoot Bubbles and bury itself. Fits in a Bucket.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.crab_bubble.description: A projectile fired by a Crab that can carry entities.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.spider_crab.description: An aquatic hostile mob that spawns in Cold Oceans and can jump, climb walls and shoot frozen bubbles.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.stranded.description: An ambient passive mob that attacks hostiles that bump into it. Can be turned on and off by waxing.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.barbed.description: An aquatic neutral mob found in Warmer Oceans that only attacks players in water. Shoots exploding Barbs.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.barb.description: An underwater entity that explodes when collided with.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.frozen_crab_bubble.descript: A projectile fired by a Crab that can carry entities.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.iguana.description: A passive mob found on Tropical Islands that can absorb sunrays and use them to cook items. Can be trusted from a young age by helping it shed.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.sneezed_salt.description: A clump of salt shot at a high velocity.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.marine_iguana.description: A passive mob found on sea stacks. Can be trusted from a young age by helping it shed.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.seal.description: A passive mob found on Cold islands and in Frozen Oceans. Can hitch you a ride at the cost of live fish. Doesn't fit into a Bucket when grown up.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.booby.description: A passive mob found on Sandy Islands that performs mating dances and mates for life.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.dodo.description: A passive defenseless mob found on Dodo islands that shoots harmless seeds at hostile mobs. It's incapable of breeding and swimming and oblivious to danger.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.melon_seed.description: A melon seed spat out at a high velocity. It's too small to deal meaningful damage.
raw_entity_translations.entity.spawn.firekeeper.description: A hostile mob made of molten rock and sunstone that can attack from long and close range.
